    action(NetworkNode[][], List<ActiveAgent>, SimulationConfig, CombatResolver) - Method in class base.ActiveAgent

    action(NetworkNode[][], List<ActiveAgent>, SimulationConfig, CombatResolver) - Method in class models.AntivirusSentinel

    action(NetworkNode[][], List<ActiveAgent>, SimulationConfig, CombatResolver) - Method in class models.RepairBot
    Act phase: pick a target that needs repair (damaged or corrupted) by priority (Core > Agents > Grid), nearest within the first non-empty category, and queue repair if adjacent.
